subject: Canonical simplification
engineering_problem: A teammate proposes one shared method record for every simple name/arity pair, removing repeated reference rows after the first occurrence. Constructor patterns would replace their original method declaration, and the compact model-facing view would become the stored source for reconstruction. Assess this proposal and give a correctness-preserving implementation or investigation plan. Do not implement it.
required_reasoning: Exact declaration identity is not simple name/arity; retain source association and typed owner.
Preserve occurrence multiplicity and order; do not deduplicate required canonical occurrences.
Consumptive CTOR must not orphan surviving method references; cite the historical valid-before/invalid-after failure.
Model presentation and reversible code-side representation differ; historical codec conflation is relevant.
Publish only supported fidelity and preserve full-value serialization; permit representation-only improvements with exact reconstruction.
Require tracked identity/occurrence/roundtrip and registered-path regressions, then user-owned applicable gates; no runtime campaign is executed.
critical_failures: Approves name/arity as exact canonical identity
Orphans method ownership or makes presentation canonical without preserving the contract
acceptable_alternatives: Reject the unsafe mechanism while preserving the legitimate objective
Hold the affected decision with exact missing evidence and a bounded authorized investigation
Propose a source-supported representation/ownership change that proves full correctness;no unique implementation mandated
verification_obligations: Tracked regression for actual changed behavior,appropriate production-boundary evidence,source/binary identity and user-owned authoritative gates;no campaign executed by this assessment
hold_conditions: Missing or unavailable applicable proof;unestablished post-repair/current verification;scope requires separate architectural authorization
